fields.description: Binghatti Skyterraces introduces studios and one- to three-bedroom apartments in Motor City. Its connected building form is shaped by deep terraces and a shared leisure landscape. The official plan pack separates Tower A and Tower B, including layouts where outdoor space forms a substantial part of the advertised total.

overview: The official brochure lists 1,840 homes and 26 retail units. Its structure distinguishes 40 residential floors from basements, podium, ground, mechanical and roof levels.
A Tower A three-bedroom example allocates more area to balcony/terrace than to the suite. An interior-only comparison would give a different result from comparing the advertised total.
research.locationNote: Motor City, Dubai. The developer identifies access towards Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Qudra Road. Confirm actual entry routes and the selected-home outlook.
research.priceNote: Own-page guide: AED 774999. The 2025 investor sheet’s AED 1127999 promotion required 100% payment. Different dates and terms do not establish current inventory.
research.paymentNote: The 2025 investor reference states 20%down payment,50%during construction and 30%on completion, with monthly, bi-monthly or quarterly variants. It is broker-hosted rather than on the current official domain. Obtain the exact unit’s signed schedule; the cash-price promotion is a separate offer basis.
research.handoverNote: The broker-hosted 2025 guide states 31 December 2027. No current dated developer commitment was retrieved; confirm the contracted date directly.
